signatures.description: Build an in-memory MVCC key-value store that enforces serializability via committed-read dependency tracking (anti-dependency edges) yet currently admits write-skew: two concurrent transactions each read a set the other writes and both commit. Requirements: capture read/write sets at snapshot isolation, detect rw-antidependency cycles only among committed-versions visible to each transaction, abort the youngest conflicting transaction with a deterministic victim rule, and prove the abort is safe under a concurrent garbage collector that advances the read watermark. Provide a simulation harness that replays interleavings and asserts no serialization anomaly survives across 10k randomized schedules.
